# Go Development Rules

## Build Tag

All `go build`, `go test`, `go vet`, and `go list` commands require `-tags containers_image_openpgp`. Use Makefile targets (`make build`, `make test-unit`) which set this automatically.

## Generated Files — Do Not Edit

- `zz_generated*` files
- Files with `DO NOT EDIT` or `Code generated` headers
- `internal/bindata/` (regenerate with `make bindata`)
- `testdata/` (regenerate with `make generate`)
- `*fakes/` directories (generated by counterfeiter via `go generate`)

## Single-File Verification

```bash
make verify-file FILE=path/to/file.go
```

Runs formatting, `go vet`, lint, and package tests for the containing package. Rejects vendor, testdata, bindata, generated, and fakes paths.

## Error and Log Formatting (CI-enforced)

- Error messages (`errors.New`, `fmt.Errorf`): start lowercase, no trailing punctuation.
- Log messages (`.Info()`, `.Error()`, `.Warn()`): start uppercase.

## Import Order

Three groups separated by blank lines: stdlib, third-party, internal (`github.com/operator-framework/operator-sdk/...`).

## Logging Frameworks

- `operator-sdk` CLI: use `github.com/sirupsen/logrus`
- `helm-operator` runtime: use `sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/log`
